limits: Two short clips only, no human reference transcription. Equality is not a guarantee of accuracy.
Original 18/43-second outliers were not reproduced; their root cause remains unproven.
No decoding fallback occurred in these benchmark clips.
Thread-count improvement cannot guarantee latency under shared host load.
decision: Use available CPU count capped at four (two on VPS); allow explicit TVLENS_WHISPER_THREADS. Keep decoding/model unchanged. Collect numeric Whisper timings and fallback counters, discard raw stderr.
